description:
From the fz-kdt.120 cold review (2026-09-03, d2a5f3510). At HEAD and under
120's prototype alike, List.reduce_step/3 is keyed
  [[a0_e], {:cont, [a1_1_e]}, a2]
-- free type variables in every position -- so it is ONE activation for every
user of Enum.reduce/3, and its return evidence is the JOIN over all of them.
What keeps that join from reaching users today is an accident: the @spec
results of List.reduce_cont/3 and Enum.reduce/3 (Known results instantiated
per callsite) republish a per-activation result and RE-CORRELATE the joined
evidence on the way out. fz-kdt.120's rule makes those results honestly
Underconstrained while a reducer's arrow is var-typed, the accidental repair
disappears, and the join propagates: Enum.to_list/1[non_empty_list(binary)]
publishes `return list(int | binary)` (a FALSE return fact on a correlated
activation), Enum.with_index_list/3 collapses from two activations to one
keyed list(int | binary), and a user's string lambda is analyzed for ints,
which surfaces as a phantom spec/violation on `+/2`. Two-user reproducer:
    fn main() do
      dbg(Enum.with_index(["a", "b"], fn (x, _index) -> x <> "!" end))
      dbg(Enum.with_index([10, 20], fn (x, index) -> x + index end))
    end
The same blind activation is the Q5 widening-ladder climber (shard-1 max
return changes 2 -> 6 on 00277's reduce_step/3) and part of 00277's
schedule residual. No gate can mask it: the phantom violation and
00188_enum_reduce_ill_typed's TRUE violation are structurally identical
(span in a user callable, library-activation provenance, ground non-any
args), and there is no fact recording "this row was joined across
uncorrelated users" (activation_inputs_joined is the blind projection; the
union arrives as ONE row from ONE publisher).
FIX DIRECTION: an activation key must be ground where the body's behaviour
depends on the argument (the fz-y6w dispatch-mask idea: key on what the body
reads); a var-keyed library body must at least carry per-publisher return
correlation (the return of the row a caller contributed, not the join). RED-
FIRST GATES: reduce_step/3's activation key carries no free type variable;
Enum.to_list/1[non_empty_list(binary)] returns list(binary) with NO contract
result in play; the two-user program prints `["a!", "b!"]` / `[10, 21]` on
three doors. BLOCKS fz-kdt.120.

comments.text: RESEARCH DONE (2026-09-03, prototype + corpus; report + proto183.diff in the coordinator's scratchpad, being cold-reviewed). THE MECHANISM: Types::convergence_class_at (types/mod.rs:780-796) turns a pure list slot into list(address_var) and a pure callable into address_var on the RECURSIVE key branch (World::canonical_activation_key :1884 -> convergence_collapse :845 -> Ignore arm :1016-1032) -- fz-y6w bounded specialization as documented ("list(int) and list(any) share one recursive key"). reduce_cont/3 escapes only because its mask is ListShape(Ignore) and the descent reaches the element; nest the element one list deeper and it collapses too. THE DEFECT IS LIVE AT HEAD, not only under 120: repro183.fz (dbg(Enum.with_index([["a"], ["b"]], fn (x, _i) -> M.strings(x) end)) beside an independent int with_index) fails with error[spec/violation]: strings/1 ... ([binary] | [int]) on interp, run AND build; delete the neighbour and it prints [1, 1]. Also proven at HEAD: swapping two independent statements flips reduce_step/3's published return FACT (fz-kdt.190). POPULATION: 146 blind-shared activations (free var in key AND >=2 publishers with different evidence) over 30 functions / 46 fixtures; Enum.reduce_while/3 32, List.reduce_cont/3 20, ... CANDIDATES measured: keep the callable in the key -> 7 fixtures hit the multi-target-closure arg-floor (fz-kdt.189, blocked behind runtime demand); per-row/per-publisher return correlation -> quicksort prints [3] (rows are the caller's own ASCENT HISTORY as well as publishers; the cross-row join IS the fixpoint); stop the coalesce blend -> sound but does not cure (fz-kdt.188). RECOMMENDED E': convergence_class_at keeps the list ELEMENT (18 lines): repro green on three doors, corpus FIFO/LIFO canon movers 2 -> 0 (dead_closure AND 00277 byte-identical), enum_predicate_search's blind-escape census empties, blind-shared 146 -> 78; cost executables 5297 -> 5383 (+1.6%) and the fz-y6w quicksort frontier bound moves (partition/4 1 -> 4; convergence still identical on every schedule) -- the bound must be RE-DERIVED, not re-pinned, which is the cold review's first question. With fz-kdt.120's prototype on top: enum_map_family GREEN, enum_tier0 + fz_f98_map_reduce oracle-exact. Gate 2 as written ("no free type variable") is not met by E' -- the callable slot stays a2 (fz-kdt.189); restate to the list and accumulator positions.

title: List.reduce_step/3 is one activation keyed entirely on free type variables: every Enum.reduce/3 user shares one body and one joined return, and only @spec results re-correlate it
